ational Gasette

PUBLISHED BY AUTHORITY

(Registered at the General Post Office, Port Moresby, for transmission by post as a Qualified Publication)

No. G251] PORT MORESBY, FRIDAY, 29th OCTOBER [2010

National Information and Communication Technology Act 2009

APPOINTMENT OF EXECUTIVE AND NON-EXECUTIVE MEMBERS OF THE NATIONAL
INFORMATION AND TECHNOLOGY AUTHORITY BOARD

I, Grand Chief Sir Paulias Matane, G.C.L., G.C.M.G.,, K.St.J., Governor-General, by virtue of the powers conferred by
Section 13(1) of the National Information and Communication Technology Act 2009 and all other powers me enabling,
acting with, and in accordance with, the advice of the National Information and Communication Technology Authority
Appointments Committee, hereby appoint:—

(a) Ansga Palaua as Chairman to be non-executive member of the Board for a term of 5 years; and
(b) ore Veve as a member to be non-executive member of the Board for a term of 4 years; and
(c) Bob Horton as an independent expert to be non-executive member of the Board for a term of 3 years; and

(d) Charles Punaha as Chief Executive Officer, (ex-officio) to be executive member of the Board for a term of
4 years,
commencing on and from 29th October, 2010.

Dated this 29th day of October, 2010.

PAULIAS MATANE,
Governor-General.

Printed and Published by K. Kaiah, Government Printer,
Port Maresby.—295.
